The sections below follow the lecture sequence. Each section includes its original lecture PDF.

- [**3.1 The derivative at a point**](09-derivative-at-a-point.qmd) — Instantaneous velocity, tangent lines, and the limit definition.
- [**3.2 The derivative function**](10-derivative-function.qmd) — Higher-order derivatives, notation, differentiability and continuity, and practice.
- [**3.3 Differentiation rules**](11-differentiation-rules.qmd) — Power, product, and quotient rules, higher-order derivatives, and tangent lines.

- [**3.4 Rates of change**](12-rates-of-change.qmd) — Velocity, acceleration, sign graphs, and finding the time of an event.
- [**3.5 Trigonometric derivatives**](13-trigonometric-derivatives.qmd) — Spring motion, trigonometric rules, worked examples, and practice.

- [**3.6 The chain rule**](14-chain-rule.qmd) — Composite functions, powers of functions, and worked examples with colored derivative factors.

- [**3.7 Derivatives of inverse functions**](15-inverse-functions.qmd) — Inverse derivatives, inverse trigonometric functions, and proofs.
- [**3.8 Implicit differentiation**](16-implicit-differentiation.qmd) — Tangent slopes, horizontal and vertical tangents, and worked practice.
